# Version 4.155.3 (Unreleased)
> **Uno WebAssembly linking fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.3 fixes WebAssembly linking for Uno 6.x applications using the Skia renderer on .NET 9 and later.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Uno WebGPU linker flags corrected** — Uno WebAssembly builds on .NET 9 and later no longer receive -sUSE_WEBGPU, which conflicts with Dawn's WebGPU port and prevented linking. .NET 8 builds retain the flag for their built-in WebGPU port. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5835))
